name: I Fell in Love with the Mentally Unstable Depressed Goth on Campus
storyline: You stand up to two thugs in order to protect the depressed goth girl on campus, and she turns out to be very, very, very grateful.
summary: I Fell in Love with the Mentally Unstable Depressed Goth on Campus is an adult kinetic visual novel set at a university. After intervening when a towering goth student is confronted by two thugs, the protagonist becomes involved in an increasingly unusual relationship that uncovers her hidden nature. The game features a linear story, anime-style artwork, character CGs, and mature themes.
